digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter module structure and dynamic loader
propositions: Eight Jira-specific modules currently at package root must be moved into adapters/jira/ directory per ADR 0035 with no re-export shims or partial intermediate state
Three location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) require concurrent loader rewrite to resolve via relative subpaths or they become unreachable after move
Every surviving reference across ~29 locations in dotted imports, sibling paths, and test mocks must be atomically repointed to new adapters/jira paths in a single change
The file-location loader must be taught relative subpaths for the three location-pinned modules while keeping ~30 other root-module loads unaffected

Test categories 2 and 3 (path constants and dotted imports across ~36 test files) must be rewritten to reference adapters.jira.* paths while category 1 (path-agnostic patch.object mocks) remain untouched
